**Overall: 82** (desktop 82, tablet 84, mobile 84)

What I found in the `[data-section="about"]` scope:

**Solid** - the desktop section renders at exactly 1440×948, matching the Figma frame. The 12-column geometry is precise: left block ends at x=480, right block starts at x=618 (the deliberate 138px column-5 trough), row 2 at y=332, 96px bottom padding. Card metrics (432×146, 12px stack gap, 24px padding, 8/28px internal gaps, LinkedIn glyph pinned 24px top/right at 60%) all check out. Type tokens verified from computed styles: Exposure 450 48px/48px at −1.92px, ink `rgb(41,29,29)`. I sampled the PNG: the eyebrow's darkest pixel is `#747474`, which is exactly 60% of `#191919` on white, so opacity is right. The FPO badge is correctly not shipped and the "OUR TEAM" chip correctly has no scrim.

**Three actionable defects:**

1. **Trades list overruns its measure** (warning) - it stretches the full 774px of columns 6-12 instead of the spec'd 659px inner block. Measured from the PNG: the second bullet column starts at x=1017 rather than ~959, so the right-hand labels sit ~58px too far right.
2. **Team photo absent** (warning) - the 774×520 figure is just the grey `photo-placeholder` gradient. The frame, radius, hairline and chip are all correct; only `about-team.jpg` (node 182:2560) is missing from the repo. Not critical since Figma itself marks it FPO, but it's the largest block in the section.
3. **~140px void above the trades lead on tablet and mobile** (warning) - the intro's `pb-16` exists only to align the two desktop grid rows, but it isn't scoped to `lg:`, so at narrower widths it stacks with the row gap and the trades `pt-6`. Scoping both paddings to `lg:` fixes it.

The spec-match pass flagged `font-size: 4px` as off-token seven times; that's the bullet arrow glyph, which the spec explicitly mandates at 4px, so I did not count it as a defect.

I made no edits to any project files.
